entities.name: Onur Şipal
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Onur Şipal is a Turkish amateur boxer who competed at the 2008 and 2016 Summer Olympics. He is a southpaw and competes in the welterweight division. His brother Önder Şipal is also an amateur boxer.
